connections.description: Send REX videos to After Effects: a generated script builds a comp with the footage, scene markers and editable title layers.
connections.setupHint: Requires After Effects in /Applications. Enable Settings ▸ Scripting & Expressions ▸ “Allow Scripts to Write Files and Access Network” and allow REX to control After Effects when macOS asks.
